name: EditableText
description: An interactive text component that can be edited in-place, transforming between text display and input field modes based on user interaction.
usage: Use for in-place editing of titles, labels, and short text content.
Double-clicking text or clicking the optional pencil icon enters edit mode.
Control whether to show the pencil icon with the `showEditIcon` prop.
Edit mode includes a text input with save (check) and cancel (X) buttons.
Pressing Enter in the input field saves the changes, Escape cancels them.
Style the component with `className` and the input with `inputClassName`.
Use the `disabled` prop to prevent editing.
design: The component maintains the same text styling when transitioning between display and edit modes.
Input field width dynamically adjusts to match the text content length.
Edit icon (pencil) only appears on hover when `showEditIcon` is true, following progressive disclosure patterns.
Action buttons use semantic colors: success (green) for save, error (red) for cancel.
The component visually indicates its disabled state with reduced opacity.
Edit mode uses a slightly different background color to indicate the mode change.
accessibility: Appropriate aria-labels are provided for the edit, save, and cancel buttons.
The component maintains focus when transitioning to edit mode.
When entering edit mode, text is automatically selected for easy replacement.
Keyboard support includes Enter to save and Escape to cancel edits.
Disabled state properly prevents interaction with appropriate cursor styling.

props.name: value
props.description: The text value to display and edit.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Callback function executed when the edited text is saved (via Enter key or save button).

props.name: showEditIcon
props.description: Whether to show the pencil icon beside the text which can be clicked to enter edit mode.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the text container.

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Additional CSS class specifically for the input element when in edit mode.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when value is empty.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the editable text is disabled, preventing any editing.
